title: MIMO subnetworks with Mirror member views
hypothesis: In a four-member MIMO synthetic classification task, member-specific Givens views on one shared hidden trunk and classifier will preserve per-task accuracy within 2 percentage points of standard MIMO member heads, retain pairwise prediction disagreement within 0.05, and reduce actual inference payload by at least 15% versus member heads; a scalar output-gate control tests the cheapest non-Mirror explanation.
physical_object: one two-layer 2->32->32 shared MIMO trunk and classifier
mirror_coordinate: one learned Givens angle per MIMO member rotating the first two hidden coordinates before a shared output head
logical_multiplicity: four member-conditioned synthetic classifiers in one MIMO forward batch
controls: standard MIMO shared trunk with independent member output heads
hard-tied MIMO shared trunk and output head
shared MIMO head with per-member scalar output gate
shared MIMO head with per-member Givens Mirror view on first two hidden coordinates
metrics: pairwise member prediction disagreement on common probes

storage.authority: actual deterministic fixed-timestamp ZIP/NPY inference payload bytes
paid_objects: member heads, gates or Mirror angles
storage.optimizer_state: training-only and excluded from inference payload; optimizer updates and training compute reported separately

gates.promising: Across all 3 fresh seeds, Mirror macro accuracy is within 2 percentage points of standard MIMO heads, member disagreement is within absolute 0.05, Mirror payload <=0.85x standard MIMO payload, and Mirror is not dominated by scalar-gate control at comparable bytes/quality.
gates.fail: Mirror misses the accuracy margin in >=2 fresh seeds, or disagreement differs by >0.10 in >=2 seeds without an accuracy benefit, or Mirror payload >= standard MIMO heads in >=2 seeds.
gates.not_established: fresh data leakage, serialization mismatch, or training instability prevents valid matched comparison

boundaries: small synthetic task family, not natural benchmark
fixed-update result is learning efficiency, not capacity
four member labels and task identity supplied by batch slot
MIMO uses multi-input batches and member outputs; no claim to reproduce every PA42 training detail
